system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.
human:
Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Model this mission for a fluid-power robotic actuator system named AirStageConserveB: Complete a repeated actuation cycle while limiting hydraulic or pneumatic energy use. The physical system is as follows. A 42 kg vertical carriage moves through 0.70 m using a double-acting pneumatic cylinder with unequal chamber areas and explicit dead volumes. Independent fill and exhaust proportional valves regulate both chambers and the allowed command magnitude is 0.012 kg/s. Include realistic return pressure, valve saturation, and thermal or compressibility effects. Instrument the scenario as follows: Measure supply flow, pressure, actuator state, and accumulated energy or air mass. Control it using energy-aware motion control with bounded performance degradation. During the middle third, inject a controlled 126 N load variation disturbance. Run at 100 Hz for 10 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Require all physical bounds, cycle completion, terminal error, and declared energy or air-use cap, primary tracking error below 0.024 m after 6.5 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
